note: Hand detector parameters (tools/handdet.py), shared by the hand watchdog and the loop's clear check. Fitted on labelled e-stop frames; refit with fit_handdet.py (keeps every labelled hand detected).
provenance: 41 labelled e-stop images 16:19-18:13Z (manual visual labels, work/handdet/labels_features.tsv): skin colour box unchanged from the first detector, close-view value floor 130 (warm speckles on the dark mat had median value 103-108, hands 167-249), area rules from the labelled blobs
roi_note: x0, y0, x1, y1; the top view starts at y0 = 0: people reach in over the far edge (a 30 px crop missed 6 of 17 labelled top-view hands)
area_note: a blob is a hand when its area reaches area_alone, or area_edge when it touches the frame edge (people reach in from outside the frame)
far_band_note: close view: the top fraction of the frame beyond the table's far edge; a blob only there needs the top camera to confirm
